title: Calculator UI & Form Submission
user_story: As a user, I want a plain HTML UI served at the root route / with two number inputs, an operation picker for add/subtract/multiply/divide, and a Calculate button, so that I can enter my calculation request.
acceptance_criteria: The page loads at the root route /.
The interface contains two number input fields.
A selection control allows picking one of the four basic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide).
A Calculate button is present to submit the form.
